name: Paradise Plus
source: Sena finally has reached her last year of high school. Everything was going fine. She had her best friend Kokoro by her side, and a carefree life at her father's home. Her parents had divorced several years ago, but she didn't mind. She wasn't too fond of her mother anyway. One day, she and Kokoro made a grave mistake. As a result, her father exiles her out his home. Sena is forced to move in with her mother, no matter how much she opposes it. In this home which wasn't a home, no one knows of her life with her father. She has a new identity in her mother's town. She's going to be busy dealing with life, and she really can't trust anyone but her friend Jaden in her mother's town. Will she be able to look beyond her past?
translation: 濑奈终于迎来了高中的最后一年。一切都很顺利。她有最好的朋友心陪在身边，在父亲家里过着无忧无虑的生活。父母几年前就离婚了，但她并不在意。反正她也不太喜欢母亲。某天，她和心犯了一个严重的错误。结果，父亲把她赶出了家门。濑奈被迫搬去和母亲同住，无论她多么反对。在这个不像家的家里，没有人知道她和父亲的生活。在母亲的小镇上，她有了新的身份。她将忙于应对生活，在母亲的小镇上，除了朋友杰登，她谁也无法信任。她能超越过去吗？
